newer_changes_search: Web search for MISS / KCC changes after the RBI circular of 13 Jan 2026 (RBI/2025-26/193): no 2026-27 MISS circular found yet; press reports say MISS is to continue to 2031-32 with the same budget, with a possible cut in lender subvention under discussion. The RBI KCC Directions, 2026 take effect 1 Jan 2027 and exclude MISS. The content now follows the RBI circular (Rs 3 lakh overall, Rs 2 lakh sub-limit for allied-only farmers, 4% with prompt repayment) rather than the PIB backgrounder's Rs 5 lakh MISS claim; correct, since the RBI circular is the operative instruction for 2025-26.
